title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Supporting and Ensuring the Construction of the Guangdong-Macao In-Depth Cooperation Zone in Hengqin
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Supporting and Promoting the Construction of the Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone

Fa Fa [2022] No. 4

To deeply study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on the cooperative development of Hengqin by Guangdong and Macao, conscientiously implement the "Overall Plan for the Construction of the Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone" issued by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, give full play to the role of judicial services and guarantees, and provide high-quality judicial services and stronger judicial guarantees for the construction of the Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone (hereinafter referred to as the Hengqin Cooperation Zone), the following opinions are formulated based on the actual work of the people's courts.

I. Overall Requirements

1. Guiding Ideology

Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of the 19th Central Committee, deeply implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, and in accordance with the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, innovate and improve judicial policies, coordinate and promote in-depth legal cooperation between Guangdong and Macao, comprehensively advance the construction of the rule of law, promote the moderately diversified development of Macao's economy, support Macao's long-term prosperity and stability, and further integrate it into the overall national development landscape.

2. Main Objectives

Further emancipate the mind, persist in reform and innovation, advance the alignment of legal rules and mechanisms with Macao under the "one country, two systems" framework, actively participate in the formulation of the regulations of the Hengqin Cooperation Zone, and enhance the level of judicial exchanges and cooperation between the Mainland and Macao. Strive to create a safe, stable, transparent, orderly, mutually beneficial, and win-win legal environment in the Hengqin Cooperation Zone, fully promote the "second entrepreneurship" of the Zhuhai Special Economic Zone in the new era, and make positive contributions to the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

II. Promoting Rule Alignment and Mechanism Connectivity

3. Improve the Mechanism for Ascertaining and Applying Foreign Law. Support the establishment of an institution for the ascertainment of foreign law at the Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone People's Court (hereinafter referred to as the Hengqin Court), focusing on strengthening the ascertainment services for foreign law, including laws of Portuguese-speaking countries (regions) and Macao. Support domestic and foreign legal experts in appearing before the Hengqin Court to provide assistance in the ascertainment of foreign law. Support the Hengqin Court in applying for authorization to pilot and explore mechanisms for the application of foreign law. Under the premise of not violating the basic principles of our country's laws or impairing national sovereignty, security, and social public interest, permit enterprises registered in the Hengqin Cooperation Zone with investment from Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, or foreign investors to agree to choose foreign law to resolve contract disputes, or to apply international treaties, international practices, and international commercial rules to resolve disputes.

4. Establish a Diversified Commercial Dispute Resolution Mechanism. Support the Hengqin Court in deepening the construction of a "one-stop" diversified dispute resolution mechanism, encouraging it to coordinate work with domestic and foreign commercial arbitration institutions, mediation organizations, and other legal service institutions, and promoting the rational allocation and efficient use of social dispute resolution resources. Support the Hengqin Court in cooperating with relevant institutions in Portuguese-speaking countries (regions), admit qualified mediation organizations and mediators from foreign countries, Hong Kong, and Macao to participate in the mediation of disputes in areas such as international commerce and intellectual property, and explore the pilot acceptance by the Hengqin Court of judicial confirmation cases for such mediation agreements.

III. Strengthening the Functions and Roles of the Hengqin Court

5. Deepen Institutional and Mechanism Reforms. Support the Hengqin Court, based on its own functional positioning and the development needs of the Hengqin Cooperation Zone, to apply for authorization according to law to deepen reforms and innovations in organizational systems, institutional setups, and functional orientations, striving to build a new model demonstration court that highlights the advantages of "one country, two systems."

6. Promote the Optimization of the Rule of Law Business Environment. Properly adjudicate cases involving companies, finance, intellectual property, and consumer rights protection, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of various market entities in the Hengqin Cooperation Zone, maintain the investment confidence of market entities, and build a market-oriented, law-based, and internationalized business environment oriented towards the protection of property rights, maintenance of contracts, fair competition, effective supervision, and unified markets.

7. Enhance the Level of Smart Court Litigation Services. Support the Hengqin Court in strengthening the construction of smart courts, with the goals of "one-stop online service" and "one-time completion," improve the construction of an international, standardized, and intelligent litigation service platform, focus on building a new mechanism for full-process online litigation and a new model for litigation services, strengthen the alignment of litigation services with Hong Kong and Macao, and provide convenient, efficient, and low-cost dispute resolution services for domestic and foreign parties.

8. Actively Extend Judicial Functions. Establish consultation, research, and risk warning mechanisms with the functional departments of the Hengqin Cooperation Zone, strengthen the sorting and analysis of cases involving Hong Kong and Macao enterprises, regularly report typical cases or relevant situations, provide references for enterprises to prevent legal risks, and give play to the guiding function of the judiciary.

IV. Deepening Judicial Cooperation and Exchanges between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao

9. Simplify Litigation Procedures in Cases Involving Hong Kong and Macao. Support the Hengqin Court in simplifying the judicial confirmation of the litigation subject qualification of Hong Kong and Macao parties, witnessing of authorization, service procedures, and the examination and determination of litigation evidence. Support the establishment of a direct entrusted service and evidence collection mechanism between the Hengqin Court and the courts of the Macao Special Administrative Region to improve the efficiency of litigation in civil and commercial disputes involving Hong Kong and Macao.

10. Strengthen Judicial Exchanges with Hong Kong and Macao. Implement the exchange visits and routine communication mechanisms between the Zhuhai and Macao courts, promote the simplification of approval procedures for cross-border judicial exchanges and cooperation, strengthen exchanges and cooperation among judicial departments in Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, enhance exchanges and studies on the sharing of judicial resources, professional training, and research topics in Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao, and cultivate a talent team with an international perspective and professional capabilities.

V. Strengthening Organizational Guarantees

11. Strengthen Organizational Leadership. We must thoroughly implement the general requirements for Party building in the new era, deeply implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of the 19th Central Committee, and conscientiously implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. Taking the development of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and the construction of the Hengqin Cooperation Zone as an opportunity, further deepen the comprehensive supporting reforms of the people's court judicial system, adhere to a systematic concept, strengthen overall coordination, ensure that all reforms are based on law and coordinated in advancement, and ensure that all measures are practical, effective, scientific, and efficient.

12. Improve the Working Mechanism. All relevant units of the Supreme People's Court shall strengthen guidance in their respective fields. The First Circuit Court and the First International Commercial Court shall enhance their initiative and foresight in serving the major decisions and deployments of the Central Committee, fully utilize the convenience of being stationed in Guangdong, base themselves on judicial functions, actively serve the major strategy of the Hengqin Cooperation Zone construction, and continuously promote the reform process. The Guangdong High People's Court shall consolidate the main responsibility, strengthen supervision and implementation, actively seek support from relevant departments, gather synergy in service guarantees, and accelerate the implementation of various construction and reform tasks.

January 17, 2022
